# usnews.com API

Search and browse scholarships from the US News & World Report Scholarship Finder, including eligibility criteria, award amounts, and deadlines.

## Install / import

```python
from parse_apis.usnews_com_api import USNews
```

## Operations

Call these on the client's collection accessors (e.g. `client.<collection>.<op>(…)`) or via active-record navigation on returned objects — see [`example.py`](./example.py) for the exact call spelling. List operations return a lazy `Paginator`.

| Call | Returns | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `client.scholarships.search(keyword: Optional[str] = None, sort: Optional[SortOption \| Literal['alpha-asc', 'alpha-desc', 'amount-asc', 'best-match', 'amount-desc', 'deadline-asc', 'deadline-desc']] = None, limit: Optional[int] = None, max_fetches: int = 1000)` | `Paginator[Scholarship]` | Search scholarships by keyword with sorting and pagination. Returns up to 10-11 scholarships per page from a catalog of 13,000+. Each result includes award name, provider, description, amount, deadline, eligibility criteria (residency, enrollment, ethnicities, majors), and application requirements. When keyword is omitted, returns all scholarships. Results are paginated server-side; use the page parameter to iterate. Pagination is handled by the returned iterator; page/cursor parameters are not exposed. |

## Errors

| Error | Raised when | Carries |
|---|---|---|
| `InputFormatInvalid` | A request parameter has an invalid format | — |

Runtime errors (`RateLimitError`, `UpstreamError`, `PaginationLimitError`, …) are importable from `parse_apis` and can occur on any call.

> **Note.** Some params accept an enum whose corresponding output field is raw `str`/`list` (the wire value isn't bound to the enum). Enum members never compare equal to raw strings — compare such output values against `member.value`, or use plain string literals.
